dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.content: Two heterogeneous robots (a legged Spot and a wheeled Fetch) operate in one shared multi-floor scene. Complete the benchmark objective: ensure that a robot reaches the object any_targets|0, and ensure that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position TARGET_any_targets|0. Decide yourselves how to divide the work between the available robots and carry it out.

assessment.objective: Complete the benchmark by ensuring that a robot reaches object any_targets|0 and that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position TARGET_any_targets|0.
constraints: Operate within the shared multi-floor scene using the available Spot and Fetch robots.
Robot assignment and division of work are delegated to the system.
assumptions: The object-reach and receptacle-position-reach conditions may be satisfied by the same robot or by different robots, as determined by the system.
Reaching the specified locations is sufficient; no pickup, transport, placement, or handoff is implied.
